items.label: USAO-MA civil: SunSetter Products LP
items.detail: Consent decree entered by a federal court in Massachusetts requiring SunSetter Products LP to pay $9.25 million in civil penalties and keep a compliance program; the government alleged it failed to report to the Consumer Product Safety Commission, until 2017, a defect in about 270,000 awning covers despite consumer complaints from 2012 (a death and multiple injuries); date is the announcement date. Allegations only, no determination of liability.
